label: Super administrator
description: Runs the standard: approves registrations, holds sampling locks for review and administers every organisation.

label: Platform support
description: Reads the registry to answer questions from operators and assessors, and changes nothing.

label: Governing body administrator
description: Administers the standard on behalf of the governing body, including approving new operators.

label: Operator administrator
description: Runs a cargo terminal account: invites colleagues, maintains settings and submits the cycle.

label: Operator assessor
description: Answers the self assessment for the terminal. Held alongside the administrator role by a SPOC.

label: Operator viewer
description: Reads the terminal scores and settings without changing anything.

label: Assessor firm administrator
description: Runs an independent assessor firm account and assigns its assessors to terminals.

label: External assessor
description: Carries out the independent assessment of a terminal on behalf of an assessor firm.

label: Airport administrator
description: Runs an airport account and maintains the terminals recorded against it.

label: Airport viewer
description: Reads the published performance of the terminals at one airport.
